question: The process of removing government-imposed limits or impediments is known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Liberalisation**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The process of removing government-imposed limits or** impediments is known as liberalizatio**n
 
• **Liberalization is the process of removing government-imposed barriers or restrictions.**
 
• This can occur **when something that was previously prohibited is no longer prohibited, or when government regulations are reduced**
 
• **Example**
 
 
• **​**In 1991, India lifted restrictions and opened up its economy for foreign investors.
 
• This was part of the LPG Reforms, **which had three pillars: liberalization, privatization, and globalization. **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Privatization:

 
 
• It is the increment of the dominating role of private sector companies and the reduced role of public sector companies.
 
• In other words, it is the reduction of ownership of the management of a government-owned enterprise.
 
• Government companies can be converted into private companies in two ways:
 
 
• By disinvestment
 
• By withdrawal of governmental ownership and management of public sector companies.
 
 
 
 
 
• Globalization:
 
 
• It means integrating the economy of one country with the global economy.
 
• During Globalization the main focus is on foreign trade & private and institutional foreign investment. 
 
• The main aim of Globalization is to transform the world towards independence and integration of the world as a whole by setting various strategic policies.
 
• Globalization is attempting to create a borderless world, wherein the need of one country can be driven from across the globe and turn into one large economy.
